general_information.Description: This course covers technical skills to design and develop high-quality object-oriented software systems using the C# programming language and students will learn how to develop video games using the C# programming language and the Unity game engine on Windows or Mac
general_information.StudentTasks: Students complete the online courses MOOC1-MOOC3 (see details in the Materials page) and get certifications for MOOC1-MOOC3 to be allowed to take Final Exam
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Visual Studio 2022 and MS SQL Server 2016 or later
general_information.Note: 1. Students complete the online courses MOOC1-MOOC3 (see details in the Materials sheet) and get certifications for MOOC1 - MOOC3 to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam: 100% 3. Bonus 1 point when complete the courses before deadline 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score + bonus >= 5

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand and using OOP in C# .NET
Understand and using LINQ & Generic collection in C# .NET

schedule.Topic: Course Introduction Basics of C# programming -Object-oriented (OO) programming -Classes, objects, properties, static and non-static members -Control statements, and the difference between call by value and call by reference.
schedule.Student's Tasks: - Enroll to the Spec on Coursera for FPT University Platform. - Watch all videos, read all materials in the module. - Finish quiz and assignement. - All Students should participate in review slot (if any question).

schedule.Topic: Basics of C# programming -Main concepts of object-oriented programming including data encapsulation, inheritance, abstract classes, interface, and polymorphism. -The exception handling techniques using language-defined exceptions and user-defined exceptions.
schedule.Student's Tasks: - Enroll to the Spec on Coursera for FPT University Platform. - Watch all videos, read all materials in the module. - Finish quiz and assignement. - All Students should participate in review slot (if any question).

schedule.Topic: Basics of C# programming -One-dimensional arrays, multi-dimensional arrays, and jagged arrays. -The generic data collections: List , Dictionary , SortedList , Stack , Queue , etc. -LINQ language and how to use it to query data from a data source.

schedule.Topic: Project : Create C# App Inheritance, Composition, and Aggregation -Create a C# Base Class called Employee. -Inherit from a C# Base Class called Employee to create a Manager. -Add a C# list of Employees to the Manager. -Add a Car C# class to demonstrate Aggregation with the Manager. -Combine the Manager, Car and Employee into one C# application to demonstrate C# Class Re-use.
